1. The simulated 13C NMR shows peaks at:
- 196.40 ppm (matches 196.9 ppm experimental) - carbonyl carbon
- 137.56 ppm (matches 137.8 ppm experimental) - ipso carbons
- 131.90 ppm (matches 132.6 ppm experimental) - para carbons
- 130.00 ppm (matches 130.2 ppm experimental) - ortho carbons
- 128.40 ppm (matches 128.4 ppm experimental) - meta carbons

2. The simulated 1H NMR shows aromatic protons around 7.51 ppm, which falls within the experimental ranges of 7.46-7.83 ppm.

This confirms that the compound is indeed benzophenone. The SMILES string O=C(c1ccccc1)c1ccccc1 represents this structure correctly.
